items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: No, I don't remember any of those. I was too little then.

ctx.x: No, I don't remember any of those. I was too little then.
The first migration, an early migration, I should say, an early migration, and the Creole band, which included Kepler, was out there. They were out there, uh-huh. In maybe 11, 1911.
Well, I came back to, I came to Chicago then, in 1911. And then, uh, Mr. Charles-
